title: orders.job-entered-production.v1
description: A garment started being made, and the workflow version was pinned. That pinning is what the payload exists to announce: a consumer reporting on how a garment was actually made needs the version that was in force, not whichever is current when it asks. The satisfied finish_before prerequisites the command was checked against are not published — they are an application input the domain verifies and does not store, a fact about the call rather than about the garment. Phase state is not published either: it is issue #33's, and an event lands with the issue that raises it.
$comment: additionalProperties is true on purpose. conventions.md section 5.5 permits additive changes within a major version, so a subscriber must tolerate a field it has not seen; a closed schema would make every such addition breaking. required lists the fields present when v1 was published — a field added within v1 is optional forever, because a dead-lettered message replayed later carries the payload as it was written.

eventId.description: Identity of this occurrence. Delivery is at least once; consumers de-duplicate on it.

aggregateId.description: The garment job, ordered behind its orders.garment-job-created.v1.

organisationId.description: The organisation the garment belongs to.

branchId.description: The branch whose workshop is making it.

orderId.description: The order the garment belongs to.

garmentJobNumber.description: The human reference, so a rack tag can be named.

workflowDefinitionId.description: The workflow definition recorded at confirmation. Repeated here so a consumer need not join back to the creation event to answer the commonest question about this one.

workflowVersionId.description: The version pinned at this moment, which never migrates: a later published workflow version does not move a running job, and an order revision is refused from here on (INV-JOB-02). Never null and never the empty uuid — the command refuses one and pins the version before returning.

schemaVersion.description: The payload's major version. Agrees with the .v suffix of eventType.
